envelope.description: Carry the diagram records onto the docs-content message

body.title: Carry the diagram records onto the docs-content message
body.summary: Add three optional fields to the docs-content variant of HostToWebview (protocol.ts), each typed by INDEXING off DocsContent so protocol → client → daemon stay one declaration deep: `erDefinition`, `sequenceDefinition`, `companions`. Forward them in openDoc by conditional spread beside the existing degradation/functionalDefinition spreads. The webview has no code for them yet, so the rendered surface must be UNCHANGED — and because nothing is inlined into the script yet, the S002 shell baseline is still the correct pin here.
acceptanceChecks: openDoc forwards all three records BY REFERENCE on the existing docs-content message — no new message type, no new IPC method, no second round trip
An absent record is an ABSENT KEY in the posted payload, asserted with `'erDefinition' in payload === false` rather than a loose falsy check
openDoc's FAIL-CLOSED arm posts blocked:true and carries NONE of the three records — so a reviewer who could not read the body can never be shown a diagram drawn from it
The emitted shell is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pinned S002 baseline (sha256 + char + byte counts unchanged): this task moves data, not pixels, and nothing has joined the script yet
The full docs-review suite still passes with NO test modified

tests.name: openDoc: forwards erDefinition, sequenceDefinition and companions BY REFERENCE on the existing docs-content message
openDoc: an absent record stays an ABSENT KEY across postMessage ('erDefinition' in payload === false)
openDoc: the fail-closed arm posts blocked:true and carries NO records and NO companions
shell: emitted HTML is byte-identical to the pinned S002 baseline (sha256 + char + byte) — this task moves data, not pixels
